labs.research_summary: Private nonprofit economics research organization whose research is done mostly by affiliated scholars at universities, with a small in-house staff in Cambridge.
labs.member_breakdown: 44 in-house staff: president, accounting and finance, conferences, research and grants management, IT, office management, communications, publications, human resources
labs.join_notes: The staff positions page says there are no open positions now. The research assistant page links to one full-time RA posting for a University of Chicago faculty pair (summer 2027) and to hourly hiring forms. The RA page states the NBER has no internship program.
labs.notes: Staff count is the number of named people on the NBER Staff page (shared inboxes not counted). These are administrative staff; researchers are affiliates at other institutions and are not counted. The RA posting is with university faculty, not NBER staff. The staff page gives work email addresses for each person; none recorded here beyond the general inbox. Programs and working groups are not listed as entries because no leads or sites are shown on the pages read.
